adjudication_incomplete.fix: Synthetic: give one outcome per case id. History: give one `runs` entry per completed trial, with a judgment for every finding id in it. Add nothing for blocked or not-run trials, and no unknown ids.
adjudication_incomplete.summary: The labels don't cover exactly the evaluated cases, completed trials or returned findings, so scoring would be partial.

adjudication_label_conflict.fix: Synthetic: use confirmed-hit or miss for expected defects, clean or false-alarm otherwise. History: a confirmed-hit must name an expected label whose paths include the finding's file; other outcomes need `label: null`.
adjudication_label_conflict.summary: A judgment contradicts the held-out ground truth, such as a hit on a control or a label that isn't an expected target.

adjudication_unknown_finding.fix: Use only the full finding ids from this exact report, as listed by `finassist report trace`. Remove ids from other reports or reruns; a mapping for another request can't adjudicate this one.
adjudication_unknown_finding.summary: The adjudications file names a finding id that isn't in this gate report, so it may belong to another review.

adjudications_invalid.fix: Map each full finding id to an object with exactly `outcome` (Confirmed, Partly right or Refuted) and `note` (a string of at most 2000 characters). Omit a finding to leave it Unresolved.
adjudications_invalid.summary: The adjudications mapping is malformed: not an object, over 50 entries, or an entry without a valid outcome and note.

approval_cannot_be_supplied_in_content.fix: Remove `status` from the observation file and rerun `finassist evidence add`; every new entry starts as a draft. Then inspect it and run `finassist evidence approve --id ID --approve-hash HASH`.
approval_cannot_be_supplied_in_content.summary: The observation includes a status field, but approval can only be recorded by a separate approve or reject action.

approved_evidence_absent.fix: Check `--entity`, `--metric` and any period or unit filters. If the entry is still a draft, inspect it and record a decision with `finassist evidence approve --id ID --approve-hash HASH`.
approved_evidence_absent.summary: No approved evidence entry matches the requested entity, metric and filters; drafts and rejected entries never match.

eval_fixture_git_failed.fix: Make sure each case's `before` and `after` differ (an empty second commit fails), your git supports `git init -b` (Git 2.28 or later), and each git step can finish within 15 seconds. Then rerun.
eval_fixture_git_failed.summary: A git command that builds a temporary synthetic evaluation fixture failed or timed out, so the case can't run.

eval_suite_approval_required.fix: Inspect the suite, then rerun with `--approve-suite` set to the `suite_hash` printed on stdout. With `--history-suite` the hash also binds `--trials`, so keep the same count; any suite edit needs a new approval.
eval_suite_approval_required.summary: A model evaluation needs --approve-suite set to the exact hash of the inspected suite, and it is missing or different.

evaluation_hash_mismatch.fix: Don't edit the evaluation. Set the labels' `evaluation_hash` to the evaluation's exact value; history labels may hold only `evaluation_hash` and `runs`. If the evaluation changed, regenerate it with `finassist evaluate` and re-adjudicate.
evaluation_hash_mismatch.summary: The evaluation no longer matches its evaluation_hash, or the labels are bound to a different evaluation.

evidence_approval_hash_mismatch.fix: Don't guess the hash or edit the store. Use the exact `id` and `hash` printed by `finassist evidence add` for the entry you inspected, then rerun approve or reject.
evidence_approval_hash_mismatch.summary: The --id doesn't exist or --approve-hash doesn't match that entry's stored content hash, so no decision is recorded.

evidence_decision_already_recorded.fix: Leave the recorded decision as is. To correct it, add a new revision with `finassist evidence add --input FILE --supersedes ID`, then approve or reject that entry.
evidence_decision_already_recorded.summary: This evidence entry was already approved or rejected, and a decision is final for a revision.

evidence_integrity_failed.fix: Don't edit or retry against this store. Preserve the file, run `finassist evidence verify`, restore the store from a trusted backup, and compare it with the damaged copy.
evidence_integrity_failed.summary: A stored approved evidence payload no longer matches its recorded hash, so the store may have been altered.

evidence_lineage_mismatch.fix: Pass `--supersedes` the id of the prior revision with the same entity, metric, unit, period start, end and kind. A changed period or unit is a separate fact: add it without `--supersedes`.
evidence_lineage_mismatch.summary: The --supersedes entry doesn't exist or has a different entity, metric, unit or period than the new observation.

evidence_migration_target_exists.fix: Another migration may have written it first. Run `finassist evidence verify` to check the active store, and don't delete or overwrite the existing versioned file.
evidence_migration_target_exists.summary: The versioned destination store (such as evidence.v2.sqlite) already exists, so migration won't overwrite it.

evidence_migration_unavailable.fix: Preserve the file and don't edit its version. Run `finassist evidence verify` to confirm it is a finassist store; if it is, this indicates a bug - open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
evidence_migration_unavailable.summary: The evidence store reports a schema version that has no supported migration path.

evidence_revision_already_exists.fix: Supersede the latest revision instead: pass the id of the most recent entry for this entity, metric, unit and period to `finassist evidence add --input FILE --supersedes ID`.
evidence_revision_already_exists.summary: The entry named by --supersedes already has a newer revision; each revision can be superseded only once.

evidence_revision_required.fix: Rerun `finassist evidence add --input FILE --supersedes ID` with the id of the latest entry for that entity, metric, unit and period. Add a separate entry only for a different period or unit.
evidence_revision_required.summary: An entry with the same entity, metric, unit and period already exists, so the new one must be added as a revision.

evidence_scope_ambiguous.fix: Narrow the lookup with `--period-end`, `--period-start`, `--period-kind` and `--unit` until one unit and period matches, for example to separate a quarterly and an annual value.
evidence_scope_ambiguous.summary: Approved entries match the lookup but differ in unit or period, so no single latest value can be chosen.

evidence_source_changed_during_migration.fix: Don't edit the store. Close every process that writes to it, rerun `finassist evidence migrate --dry-run` to inspect the plan, then run the migration again with no writers active.
evidence_source_changed_during_migration.summary: The evidence store changed while it was being copied for migration, so the copy was discarded.

evidence_store_busy_close_writers.fix: Close every process using the store, recover it through a normal open such as `finassist evidence verify`, then retry the migration. Don't delete -wal, -shm or -journal files by hand.
evidence_store_busy_close_writers.summary: The evidence store has -wal, -shm or -journal sidecar files, so it may be in use and can't be migrated safely.

evidence_store_integrity_failed.fix: Don't edit, repair or retry against the store in place. Preserve the file, inspect a copy, restore from a trusted backup, then rerun `finassist evidence verify` and compare.
evidence_store_integrity_failed.summary: Verification found damage or tampering in the evidence store: a failed SQLite, hash, lineage or decision check.

evidence_store_missing.fix: Point `--state-dir` (or global `--audit-dir`, which takes precedence) at the directory that holds evidence.sqlite. Other evidence actions, such as `finassist evidence add`, create it.
evidence_store_missing.summary: No evidence store file exists in the selected state directory, so there is nothing to verify or migrate.

evidence_store_newer_schema_upgrade_requ.fix: Upgrade finledgerpoli before opening this store. `store_schema` and `supported_schema` show the versions involved. Don't edit or downgrade the store.
evidence_store_newer_schema_upgrade_requ.summary: The evidence store was written by a newer finledgerpoli and uses a schema this version can't read.

evidence_store_schema_invalid.fix: Preserve the file and inspect a recovery copy; this release doesn't initialize or repair an existing store's layout. Check that `--state-dir` points at the intended store.
evidence_store_schema_invalid.summary: The existing evidence store lacks required tables or triggers, so it is empty, partial or not a finassist store.

evidence_store_schema_mismatch.fix: Don't rename evidence store files. Restore the original file names, run `finassist evidence verify`, and create versioned copies only with `finassist evidence migrate`.
evidence_store_schema_mismatch.summary: The version in the store's file name (such as .v2) doesn't match the schema version recorded inside the file.

evidence_store_unavailable.fix: Close other processes using the store and retry; opens wait up to 15 seconds for a writer. Check permissions and that the file is the intended store. Don't delete journal or WAL files by hand.
evidence_store_unavailable.summary: SQLite couldn't open or read the evidence store; it may be locked, unreadable or not a database.

finding_identity_invalid.fix: Don't edit the report; regenerate it with `finassist gate run`. A legacy v1 report with findings needs a `request_sha256` and integer `line` values. If a fresh gate run shows this, open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
finding_identity_invalid.summary: A gate report finding can't be given a stable id because its request hash, position or fields are missing or malformed.

history_adjudication_duplicate.fix: Merge them into one `runs` entry per `case_id` and `trial`, keeping a single judgment for each finding id.
history_adjudication_duplicate.summary: The history labels contain two entries for the same case id and trial.

history_adjudication_invalid.fix: Give each `runs` entry exactly `case_id`, an integer `trial` and a `findings` object. Each judgment needs exactly `outcome` (confirmed-hit, confirmed-other, false-alarm or unresolved) and `label`.
history_adjudication_invalid.summary: The history labels are malformed: runs isn't a list of at most 1000 entries, or an entry or judgment has the wrong shape.

history_case_invalid.fix: Give each case `id`, `repo_path`, `base_sha`, `head_sha`, `profile`, `expected` and `negative_control`, plus an optional `policy`; remove any other keys.
history_case_invalid.summary: A history case isn't an object or doesn't have exactly the required fields plus an optional policy.

history_cases_invalid.fix: Make `cases` a JSON array of 1 to 50 case objects; split larger benchmarks into several suites.
history_cases_invalid.summary: The history suite's cases must be a list of 1 to 50 cases.

history_ci_execution_forbidden.fix: Run the live evaluation on a trusted machine outside GitHub Actions. Offline inspection without `--allow-network` still works in CI.
history_ci_execution_forbidden.summary: Live history evaluation with --allow-network is refused inside GitHub Actions; it is for out-of-band runs only.

history_comparison_incomplete.fix: Score each evaluation alone with `finassist score --evaluation FILE --labels FILE` and resolve what makes it incomplete: blocked or not-run trials, unresolved judgments or contaminated controls. Compare only complete scores.
history_comparison_incomplete.summary: One of the compared evaluations isn't completely scored, so an overlap comparison would be misleading.

history_comparison_scope_mismatch.fix: Compare evaluations of the same frozen suite: identical case ids, base and head SHAs, source hashes, expected targets and negative-control flags. Profiles, models and policies may differ.
history_comparison_scope_mismatch.summary: The two evaluations don't cover identical cases, source pairs, source identities and ground truth.

history_cost_invalid.fix: Write `actual_usd` as a decimal string such as "0.42", or null when the cost is unknown. Don't use a JSON number, a negative value, NaN or Infinity.
history_cost_invalid.summary: A trial's actual_usd isn't null or a finite, non-negative decimal string of at most 64 characters, up to 1e9.

history_elapsed_invalid.fix: Set `elapsed_seconds` to a number of seconds from 0 to 86400, or null when the time is unknown.
history_elapsed_invalid.summary: A trial's elapsed_seconds isn't null or a finite number from 0 to 86400.

history_evaluation_invalid.fix: Use `schema_version` 2, `kind` history-evaluation, `mode` offline, model or external, integer `trials` 1-20 and 1-50 case objects. `--compare` accepts only history evaluations.
history_evaluation_invalid.summary: The file isn't a valid history evaluation envelope: wrong schema_version, kind, mode, trials or cases.

history_evaluation_size_exceeded.fix: Reduce `--trials` or the number of cases, or split the suite into smaller suites, then approve the new suite hash and rerun.
history_evaluation_size_exceeded.summary: The worst-case result of this live run could exceed the 64 MB scoring limit, so it is refused before any request.

history_expected_invalid.fix: Set `negative_control` true only when `expected` is empty. Give each target exactly a unique `label`, a `severity` (critical, high, medium, low or info) and 1-50 unique `paths`. Evaluation findings need valid severities too.
history_expected_invalid.summary: A case's expected targets are malformed, or negative_control doesn't match whether expected is empty.

history_expected_outside_scope.fix: Make each `expected` path a file changed between `base_sha` and `head_sha` and included in the review scope, or correct the range.
history_expected_outside_scope.summary: An expected target path isn't among the files the case's source range actually changes and reviews.

history_findings_invalid.fix: Make each run's `findings` an array of at most 50 objects, each with a unique `id`, a `path` and a `severity`. Keep the ids copied from the gate reports.
history_findings_invalid.summary: A trial's findings aren't a list of at most 50 objects with unique ids.

history_hash_invalid.fix: Don't edit these hashes. Copy `suite_hash` and each case's `source_hash` exactly from the local evaluation output; an external envelope must keep them unchanged.
history_hash_invalid.summary: A suite_hash or source_hash in the evaluation isn't a 64-character lowercase hex SHA-256 value.

history_identity_invalid.fix: Use 1-80 characters starting with a letter or digit, then only letters, digits, `_`, `.` or `-`. Make every case id unique. A confirmed-hit judgment needs a non-null label.
history_identity_invalid.summary: An id, label or profile name has an invalid format, or two cases share the same id.

history_incomplete_findings.fix: Keep `findings` empty for blocked, not-run and offline trials, and don't change a trial's status to fit. Regenerate the evaluation rather than editing it.
history_incomplete_findings.summary: A trial that isn't complete lists findings, but only completed trials can have findings.

history_policy_commit_invalid.fix: Set policy `commit` to a full 40-character lowercase commit SHA. If omitted it defaults to the case `base_sha`, which then must be 40-hex too.
history_policy_commit_invalid.summary: The policy commit isn't a full 40-character lowercase hex SHA.

history_policy_commit_unavailable.fix: Make the commit available in a complete local clone yourself, outside finassist, or correct policy `commit` or `repo_path`; then rerun.
history_policy_commit_unavailable.summary: The policy commit isn't present in the local policy repository, and evaluation never fetches missing objects.

history_policy_invalid.fix: Give `policy` a `path` and a `sha256` (64 lowercase hex of the committed policy bytes), plus optional `repo_path` and `commit`; remove any other keys.
history_policy_invalid.summary: A case's policy object is malformed: path or sha256 is missing, the hash isn't 64 lowercase hex, or it has extra keys.

history_policy_profile_mismatch.fix: Set the case `profile` to the profile named in the pinned policy, or pin a policy whose profile matches the case.
history_policy_profile_mismatch.summary: The case's profile differs from the profile selected by its pinned review policy.

history_policy_repository_invalid.fix: Set policy `repo_path` (default: the case `repo_path`) to a local Git repository's top-level directory, relative to the suite file or absolute. URLs and subdirectories are refused.
history_policy_repository_invalid.summary: The policy repo_path is malformed, or the directory isn't a readable local Git repository root.

history_policy_required.fix: Add a reviewed `policy` object with `path` and `sha256` to every case before using `--allow-network`, or run without `--allow-network` for offline inspection.
history_policy_required.summary: A live history evaluation needs a pinned review policy for every case, and at least one case has none.

history_policy_revision_mismatch.fix: Set policy `commit` to the full commit SHA itself, such as the output of `git rev-parse SHA^{commit}` in the policy repository.
history_policy_revision_mismatch.summary: The policy commit resolves to a different commit, for example because it names an annotated tag.

history_repository_invalid.fix: Set `repo_path` to a local path of the repository root, relative to the suite file or absolute. Remote URLs aren't supported; prepare a complete local clone first.
history_repository_invalid.summary: A case's repo_path is empty, longer than 4096 characters, not a string, or a URL.

history_repository_root_required.fix: Point `repo_path` at the repository's top-level directory, as shown by `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`, not a subdirectory.
history_repository_root_required.summary: A case's repo_path is inside a Git repository but isn't its top-level directory.

history_repository_unavailable.fix: Fix `repo_path` so it points to an existing local Git repository root, relative to the suite file or absolute.
history_repository_unavailable.summary: A case's repo_path, resolved from the suite file's directory, isn't an existing directory.

history_revision_mismatch.fix: Use full commit SHAs for `base_sha` and `head_sha`, such as the output of `git rev-parse SHA^{commit}` in that repository. Missing objects report git_commit_unavailable instead.
history_revision_mismatch.summary: A case's base_sha or head_sha resolves to a different commit, for example because it names an annotated tag.

history_run_invalid.fix: List runs in order with `trial` 1, 2, 3 and so on, each with `status` complete, blocked, not-run or offline.
history_run_invalid.summary: A trial run isn't an object whose trial equals its 1-based position and whose status is known.

history_suite_invalid.fix: Make the suite a JSON object with only `version` set to 1 and `cases`, and pass `--trials` between 1 and 20.
history_suite_invalid.summary: The history suite isn't an object with exactly version 1 and cases, or --trials is outside 1-20.

history_suite_too_large.fix: Split the cases into smaller suites or shorten them. Non-ASCII text is counted after escaping, so it can pass the limit before the raw file does.
history_suite_too_large.summary: The history suite's canonical JSON is larger than 1,000,000 bytes.

history_trials_incomplete.fix: Give every case exactly `trials` run entries, including blocked and not-run trials. Regenerate the evaluation rather than removing runs.
history_trials_incomplete.summary: A case's runs list doesn't have exactly one entry per trial declared in the evaluation.

history_unattempted_cost.fix: Set `actual_usd` and `elapsed_seconds` to null for not-run trials. An attempted trial is blocked or complete, not not-run; regenerate the evaluation rather than editing statuses.
history_unattempted_cost.summary: A not-run trial reports a cost or elapsed time, but an unattempted trial can't have either.

invalid_adjudication.fix: Set each value in `outcomes` to exactly one of confirmed-hit, miss, clean, false-alarm or unresolved.
invalid_adjudication.summary: A synthetic label uses an outcome other than confirmed-hit, miss, clean, false-alarm or unresolved.

invalid_eval_case.fix: Give each case exactly `id`, `path`, `before`, `after` and `expected_defect`, and remove any other keys.
invalid_eval_case.summary: A synthetic case doesn't have exactly the fields id, path, before, after and expected_defect.

invalid_eval_cases.fix: Make `cases` a JSON array of 1 to 50 case objects; split larger sets into several suites.
invalid_eval_cases.summary: The synthetic suite's cases must be a list of 1 to 50 cases.

invalid_eval_identity.fix: Give every case a unique, nonempty string `id`, and set `expected_defect` to the JSON boolean true or false, not a string or number.
invalid_eval_identity.summary: A synthetic case id is empty, duplicated or not a string, or expected_defect isn't true or false.

invalid_eval_source.fix: Provide nonempty `before` and `after` strings of at most 48,000 UTF-8 bytes each; trim the fixture to the lines the case needs.
invalid_eval_source.summary: A synthetic case's before or after text is empty, not a string, or larger than 48,000 bytes.

invalid_eval_suite.fix: Make the suite a JSON object with only `version` set to 1 and `cases`. For a frozen history suite, use `--history-suite` instead of `--suite`.
invalid_eval_suite.summary: The synthetic suite isn't an object with exactly version 1 and cases.

invalid_evidence_decision.fix: From the CLI this indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data. Python callers of EvidenceStore.decide must pass status approved or rejected.
invalid_evidence_decision.summary: An evidence decision used a status other than approved or rejected.

invalid_evidence_metadata.fix: Use nonempty entity, metric, unit and source; keep period_start <= period_end <= published_at <= retrieved_at; and set period_kind to quarter, annual, year-to-date, trailing or annual-stub.
invalid_evidence_metadata.summary: The observation fails point-in-time metadata checks, such as an empty field, a bad period order or an unknown period kind.

offline_run_is_not_model_evaluation.fix: Run a model evaluation first: configure a provider, inspect the suite, then rerun `finassist evaluate` with `--approve-suite HASH --allow-network`. Score that output with `finassist score`.
offline_run_is_not_model_evaluation.summary: The evaluation was produced offline, so it measures no model and can't be scored as model quality.

scope_incomplete.fix: Run `finassist plan` and read `omitted`. Add the paths to `allow_paths` or keep generated and image files out of the range; a history case also needs a changed file. Only `review` and `propose` accept `allow_partial_review`.
scope_incomplete.summary: Some changed files are omitted from the review packet, so complete coverage can't be shown and the review is refused.

trace_input_invalid.fix: Check the path names a regular file (not a link) of at most 1 MB holding a single JSON object, with no duplicate keys and no NaN or Infinity values.
trace_input_invalid.summary: The gate report or adjudications file can't be read as one JSON object of at most 1 MB.

trace_text_invalid.fix: Remove hidden characters such as zero-width spaces, bidirectional marks or control codes from each `note`; ordinary newlines and tabs are allowed.
trace_text_invalid.summary: An adjudication note contains invisible control or format characters, which trace output refuses.

triage_action_reason_invalid.fix: Pair recommend with scored; abstain with uncertain, insufficient_context or out_of_distribution; and invalid with invalid_input, inference_error or timeout.
triage_action_reason_invalid.summary: The result's reason isn't allowed for its action, for example recommend with a reason other than scored.

triage_budget_exceeded.fix: Select at most `max_selected_checks` ids in `selected_checks`. Don't raise the request's predeclared budget after seeing results.
triage_budget_exceeded.summary: The result selects more checks than the request's max_selected_checks budget allows.

triage_budget_feasible.fix: Use `applicability_reason` applicable for this confirmed case; reserve budget_infeasible for required check sets larger than `max_selected_checks`.
triage_budget_feasible.summary: The gold record says budget_infeasible, but its required checks fit within the request's budget.

triage_budget_infeasible.fix: Set `applicability_reason` to budget_infeasible; the case stays in the denominator as a routing miss. Don't raise the budget after adjudication to hide the policy failure.
triage_budget_infeasible.summary: A confirmed gold case requires more checks than the request's budget, but doesn't state budget_infeasible.

triage_budget_invalid.fix: Complete the gold `catalog` checks list, or set a predeclared `max_selected_checks` no larger than it before adjudication, then rebind gold to the new request hash.
triage_budget_invalid.summary: The request's max_selected_checks is larger than the number of checks in the gold catalog.

triage_candidate_duplicate.fix: Give every candidate a unique `id` across all three lists, then recompute any request hash bound to it.
triage_candidate_duplicate.summary: A candidate id appears more than once across the request's patterns, files and checks lists.

triage_candidate_outside_catalog.fix: Add every request candidate id to the matching gold `catalog` list (patterns, files or checks), and for patterns and checks also to one of required, optional or forbidden.
triage_candidate_outside_catalog.summary: A request candidate id is missing from the gold catalog for its group.

triage_catalog_duplicate.fix: Make every gold `catalog` id unique across patterns, files and checks.
triage_catalog_duplicate.summary: An id appears more than once across the gold catalog's patterns, files and checks lists.

triage_cohort_invalid.fix: Provide each collection as a JSON array of at most 100,000 records; split a larger cohort into separate evaluations.
triage_cohort_invalid.summary: A requests, gold or predictions collection isn't a list or has more than 100,000 rows.

triage_collection_invalid.fix: Wrap each collection as an object with only `schema_version` 1 (an integer) and its array: `requests`, `gold` or `predictions`, matching the flag it is passed to.
triage_collection_invalid.summary: A collection file isn't an object with exactly schema_version 1 and its named array.

triage_document_too_large.fix: Keep each input file and record under 2 MB; split collections and shorten context. Non-ASCII text is escaped in canonical form, so it can pass the limit first.
triage_document_too_large.summary: A triage input file or record is larger than 2,000,000 bytes, as read or after canonical encoding.

triage_duplicate_json_key.fix: Remove the duplicate so each object has each key once; the parser refuses rather than picking one value.
triage_duplicate_json_key.summary: A triage input repeats the same key within one JSON object.

triage_file_probabilities_not_normalized.fix: Normalize the `files` probability vector so its values sum to 1; pattern and check probabilities are independent and need not sum to 1.
triage_file_probabilities_not_normalized.summary: The result's file probabilities don't sum to 1 within an absolute tolerance of 1e-9.

triage_file_ranking_incomplete.fix: List every file candidate id exactly once in `ranked_files` when the action is recommend.
triage_file_ranking_incomplete.summary: A recommend result's ranked_files isn't a full permutation of the request's file candidates.

triage_file_ranking_inconsistent.fix: Sort `ranked_files` so each file's probability is greater than or equal to the next file's.
triage_file_ranking_inconsistent.summary: The ranked_files order doesn't follow nonincreasing file probability.

triage_gold_coverage_invalid.fix: Provide one gold record per request `case_id`, including unconfirmed and not_applicable cases, and remove gold for cases that aren't in the requests.
triage_gold_coverage_invalid.summary: The gold collection doesn't contain exactly one record for each request case_id.

triage_gold_duplicate.fix: Keep exactly one gold record per `case_id`; merge or remove the duplicates.
triage_gold_duplicate.summary: Two records in the gold collection share the same case_id.

triage_gold_files_invalid.fix: List each acceptable first file once, using only ids from the gold `catalog` files list.
triage_gold_files_invalid.summary: Gold acceptable_first_files has duplicates or ids that aren't in the gold catalog files.

triage_gold_identity_invalid.fix: Make every entry in the `gold` array a JSON object whose `case_id` is a string.
triage_gold_identity_invalid.summary: A record in the gold collection isn't an object with a string case_id.

triage_gold_invalid.fix: Give each gold record exactly `schema_version` 1, `case_id`, `request_hash`, `source_kind`, `family_id`, `adjudication_status`, `applicability_reason`, `is_control`, `defect_status`, `catalog`, `patterns`, `checks` and `acceptable_first_files`.
triage_gold_invalid.summary: A gold record doesn't match the gold schema, for example a missing field, an unknown key or an invalid enum value.

triage_gold_partition_invalid.fix: Put every catalog pattern and check id into exactly one of `required`, `optional` or `forbidden`, with no ids outside the catalog.
triage_gold_partition_invalid.summary: Gold required, optional and forbidden labels overlap or don't exactly cover the catalog for patterns or checks.

triage_gold_status_invalid.fix: Use confirmed with applicable or budget_infeasible, unconfirmed with pending_adjudication, or not_applicable with outside_scope.
triage_gold_status_invalid.summary: The gold adjudication_status and applicability_reason aren't an allowed pair.

triage_input_file_required.fix: Pass an existing JSON file to each input flag: `--request`, `--result`, `--requests`, `--gold`, `--predictions` and `--model-manifest`.
triage_input_file_required.summary: A triage input path doesn't name an existing regular file.

triage_input_not_canonical_json.fix: Pass plain JSON values only: dicts with string keys, lists, strings, booleans, None, integers and finite floats. NaN, Infinity, sets and custom objects are refused.
triage_input_not_canonical_json.summary: Python API inputs to the triage evaluator can't be encoded as canonical JSON.

triage_json_invalid.fix: Save the file as UTF-8 JSON whose top level is a single object, and replace out-of-range numbers such as 1e999 with finite values.
triage_json_invalid.summary: A triage input isn't valid UTF-8 JSON with one object at the top level, or a number overflows.

triage_model_manifest_invalid.fix: Give the `--model-manifest` file exactly `model_id`, `model_digest` (64 hex), `scorer_revision` (40 or 64 hex) and `calibration_digest` (64 hex), with no other fields.
triage_model_manifest_invalid.summary: The model manifest doesn't match the manifest schema.

triage_model_mismatch.fix: Pass the manifest of the model that produced the result, or regenerate the result with the pinned model. Don't edit the result's manifest to match.
triage_model_mismatch.summary: The result's model_manifest isn't identical to the expected manifest passed with --model-manifest.

triage_nonfinite_number.fix: Replace these with finite numbers; probabilities must be between 0 and 1.
triage_nonfinite_number.summary: A triage input contains NaN, Infinity or -Infinity, which the strict parser refuses.

triage_nonrecommend_selection.fix: Leave `selected_patterns`, `selected_checks` and `ranked_files` empty unless the action is recommend; keep the full probability vectors.
triage_nonrecommend_selection.summary: An abstain or invalid result lists selected patterns, checks or ranked files.

triage_prediction_duplicate.fix: Keep at most one prediction per `case_id`; remove duplicates or retried results.
triage_prediction_duplicate.summary: Two records in the predictions collection share the same case_id.

triage_prediction_identity_invalid.fix: Make every entry in the `predictions` array a JSON object whose `case_id` is a string.
triage_prediction_identity_invalid.summary: A record in the predictions collection isn't an object with a string case_id.

triage_prediction_unknown_case.fix: Remove predictions for cases that aren't in `requests`, or fix their `case_id`. Missing predictions are allowed and count as misses.
triage_prediction_unknown_case.summary: A prediction's case_id doesn't match any request in the cohort.

triage_probability_coverage_invalid.fix: For each of patterns, files and checks, give one probability row per request candidate id, with no duplicates or unknown ids.
triage_probability_coverage_invalid.summary: A probability vector doesn't list every candidate id of its group exactly once.

triage_probability_invalid.fix: Use plain JSON numbers from 0 to 1. The CLI schema check refuses bad values first, so seeing this from the CLI indicates a bug; open an issue with the command and code, without private data.
triage_probability_invalid.summary: A probability isn't a plain finite number.

triage_request_duplicate.fix: Keep one request per `case_id`, and give distinct cases distinct ids.
triage_request_duplicate.summary: Two records in the requests collection share the same case_id.

triage_request_identity_invalid.fix: Make every entry in the `requests` array a JSON object whose `case_id` is a string.
triage_request_identity_invalid.summary: A record in the requests collection isn't an object with a string case_id.

triage_request_invalid.fix: Give the request exactly `schema_version` 1, `case_id`, `task_revision`, `source_digest`, `context`, `max_selected_checks` (an integer 0-1024, not 2.0) and `candidates` with `patterns`, `files` and `checks`.
triage_request_invalid.summary: A triage request doesn't match the request schema, or max_selected_checks isn't a JSON integer.

triage_request_mismatch.fix: Set `case_id` and `request_hash` to the exact request's values; compute the hash with `finassist.triage_contract.request_hash`. If the request changed, regenerate the result and re-adjudicate gold.
triage_request_mismatch.summary: A result or gold record isn't bound to this request: its case_id or request_hash differs.

triage_result_invalid.fix: Give the result exactly `schema_version` 1, `case_id`, `request_hash`, `model_manifest`, `action`, `reason`, `probabilities`, `selected_patterns`, `selected_checks` and `ranked_files`, with probabilities from 0 to 1.
triage_result_invalid.summary: A triage result doesn't match the result schema, for example a missing or extra field or a value out of range.

triage_selection_invalid.fix: Use each id at most once in `selected_patterns`, `selected_checks` and `ranked_files`, drawn only from the request's pattern, check and file candidates respectively.
triage_selection_invalid.summary: A selection or ranking repeats an id or uses an id that isn't a candidate in that group.
